column2: 了 is the head and the bundled body, and 一 the arms stretched out across it, written last.

column3: It is a picture of a street intersection.

A person 亻 shifting 更 to a more comfortable position: that is convenient and easy.

A person 亻 bowing down low, with 氐 giving the sound dī.

A person 亻 handing a hunting tool 弋 on to the next person: one takes over from another, generation after generation.

An eye 目 with a tough, stubborn 艮 stare: that is the eye in your face.

A sun in its frame 口, with a bar 一 of light across the middle.
column3: A line was added in the middle to tell it from 口.

column2: The top 亠 is the head, and the cross 乂 below is the mark on the chest: write the head first, then the cross.

column3: Tiny things plus a guard: watching over the fine details.

column2: Observe 占 the spot, then mark it with a black 黑 dot: a point, to tick off.

column3: It pictured a person dancing with ox tails in both hands to pray for rain.

column2: Silk thread 糹 that runs on like water from a spring 泉: a long line, a string.
Leave rice 米 to a company of officials 曹 and it ends up a rotten mess.
Jade 王 with a person 人 admiring its shine 彡: a treasure, something rare.
A jade 王 bead tinted cinnabar red 朱: a bead, a pearl.
Leaves 艹 on top, a person 人 beneath them, and a tree 木 as the base: someone picking tea from a bush.
Wisdom 臤 above, money 貝 below: the wise are worth as much as money, a worthy person.

A mouth 口 sipping coffee so that you are not 非 sleepy.
Metal 釒 in tiny 戔 pieces: small coins, money.
Water 氵 that the host 主 pours into your cup: to pour in, to fill.
Someone who swallowed the wrong way: doubled over and twisting round, gasping for breath.
On the left the handcuffs 幸; on the right a kneeling person 卩 held by a hand 又: the sentence is read out and the news gets reported.
Words 言 from the host 主, who explains the text to his guests: a note explaining it.
The cliff 厂 is written first and wraps over the spring 泉 beneath it: where the water comes from, the start of things.
column3: The water was seen bursting out of a cliff-side, the place it starts from.

column2: A foot 止 stops beside a seated person 匕: stop right here, this one.
The four dots 灬 under the bird are fire: a crow looks scorched black.
A dragon rearing up: on the left a head standing 立 over a curved body 月, with the long tail trailing down on the right.
The snake of the zodiac, coiled up with the loop shut tight.
Standing 立 and watching 占 for what is coming: wait at the stop, the station.
A tiny skein of thread 幺 covered over by a lid 亠: hidden, dark, mysterious.
Write the bird 隹 first, then the walking 辶 sweeps under it and carries it on: go forward, enter.
column3: One explanation: a bird can only walk forward, never backward.

column2: Pile up the earth 土 until the work is complete 成: a finished wall, and the city inside.
column3: City walls were once made of stamped earth.

column2: Speech 言 that is meant to bear fruit 果: the lesson you sit through, a class.
Yellow loam 堇 washed along by the water 氵: the muddy Han River, and the Han people.
Words 言 you shoot 射 across to someone: a quick word of thanks.
The finest plant 艹 stands in the center 央 of the field, outstanding above the rest: the hero, the bloom.
A net 罒 cast over shell money 貝: you scoop up what you want with your cash and buy it.
Plants 艹 that you pick 采 for dinner: vegetables.
A hand 又 under a swirl in the water 氵, sinking out of sight: it is gone, not there any more.

column3: Ancient toys were made of jade.

column2: A lame 兀 walker on the path 彳 taps 攵 his way up a mountain 山: tiny, slight steps.
Water 氵 whose skin 皮 is stretched and rippling: a wave.
Meat 肉 handed over 付 and left sitting in a shed 广: it rots.
A hook 亅 with a small bit 八 on each side, like three small dots in a row.
column3: One view is that it shows three small dots, meaning small.

column2: A dragon 龍 shut in a cage woven of bamboo ⺮: a cage or steamer basket.
At dawn 卯, a metal 金 blade, a knife 刂, is raised to slay.
Strength 力 between two toilsome 辛 chores: you put in the effort to get things done.
A pole 丨 run straight through the drum 口 at the center: the middle.
column3: The box in the middle has been interpreted as a drum.
